integrity: The finite character sums are reproducible from a standalone, locally executed character-rule checker; the general exponent bound follows from the written Jucys--Murphy/Bernstein proof, not a finite experiment.
scientific_limitations: Exact generalized-roundness exponents are proved only for n=3,4,5. For general n the exponential upper rate 3/4 is not asserted optimal, and no lower exponential rate is obtained. Historical originality comparison is bounded; an unlocated broader theorem on central negative-type kernels could cover part of the claim.
title: Exponential loss of negative type in complete-transposition symmetric-group metrics
